Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high-end hand-painted fantasy game VFX element on a genuinely transparent background, PNG alpha. Single isolated effect, NO scene, NO rectangle, NO text, NO UI, NO frame. Premium League-of-Legends-like painterly VFX art, exquisitely sculpted silhouette, rich body color with thin luminous edges and controlled tiny white cores. Darker translucent textured body should retain depth; brightness concentrated in small leading edges, never a blown-out white blob. Keep all protrusions comfortably inside the image with 12% transparent padding. Square composition. This will be animated over existing sacred landscapes, preserve clean alpha edges and beautifully tapered dissipating wisps. No checkerboard.
Three massive curved spectral bear claw gouges travelling diagonally from lower-left to upper-right. Ferocious cobalt and electric cyan torn-plasma blades, white-hot sharp leading tips, branching secondary thunder filaments, jagged dark-blue negative space between three distinct talons, brushy vapor and sparks tapering behind each slash. Strong hooked talon silhouettes, raw thunderous kinetic energy, not three straight lines.
